audit.whatIsWrong: Level 2 and Levels 4-5 read Fiora and Skill while the whys give both to Mordekaiser, and Level 6 read Skill. The whys were also shifted a row: whys[2] described Levels 4-5 sitting on the Level 3 row and whys[3] described Level 6 sitting on Levels 4-5.
audit.why: The packet levelChart reads Skill / Mordekaiser / Fiora / Mordekaiser / Fiora / Fiora / Fiora, and the fiora-side audit proposed exactly that chart mirrored (win[1]=Mordekaiser, win[3]=Mordekaiser, win[4]=Fiora) — so this side had to match or the two pages would disagree.
audit.corrected: Chart set to the packet read in matched full+content pairs, ratings adjusted, and whys[2], whys[3], whys[4] plus phases[3] and phases[4] retimed onto the rows they actually sit on.

audit.whatIsWrong: Riposte was the tracked cooldown on nine surfaces with no duration, and Lunge, Bladework and Grand Challenge had no numbers at all.
audit.why: Riposte is 24s at rank 1 and Lunge 13s — both far longer than a Mordekaiser player assumes, and both are the windows the whole pattern is built on.
audit.corrected: Riposte written as 24s at rank 1 in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t; Lunge as 13s and Grand Challenge as 110s in the level chart and dontsFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: The three don’t-descriptions were generic filler under specific headers, so the two interactions that decide the lane never reached the page body: Riposte parries all incoming damage and stuns if it blocked an immobilising effect, and Grand Challenge heals her and her allies when she lands all four Vitals.
audit.why: Riot’s W text states the parry-into-stun conversion outright, which is exactly what happens to Death’s Grasp; the R text states the heal.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[0].d, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t state the parried-pull stun; dontsFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d and report[8].t cover the Vital and Grand Challenge heals with Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: Q ranks make isolated hits massive. Fiora must hug minions all lane; punish every step away from the wave with the full drag combo.
edits.after: Q drops to 6s and Darkness Rise is rolling; pull her off her Vital and the extended trade is yours while Lunge is still 13s.

edits.before: Realm of Death online — the 1v1 Fiora cannot decline. R steals 10% of her stats; take the duel whenever Riposte is down and the wave is shoved.
edits.after: Both ults land here, but hers is 110s to your 140s — Grand Challenge's four Vitals and its heal out-duel you even inside the realm.

edits.before: - Fiora Riposte: matchup-defining — Parries + stuns you. Bait it. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Fiora Riposte: matchup-defining — 24s at rank 1; it parries damage and stuns if it blocks your pull.

edits.before: Parries + stuns you. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It is 24s at rank 1 — a parried Death's Grasp stuns you outright.

edits.before: That is Fiora's favourite window — refuse it and half her win condition is gone.
edits.after: Riposte parries all damage and stuns you if it blocked the pull — bait it first.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Her Vitals heal her on every proc — bring Grievous before the long trade.

edits.before: Whiffing Q into the wave and trading with no passive stacks — un-isolated Obliterate hits soft, and without Darkness Rise you lose most even exchanges.
edits.after: Grand Challenge is 110s at rank 1 and heals her and nearby allies if she lands all four Vitals — never fight her low while it is running.

edits.before: Track Fiora's Riposte: Parries + stuns you. Bait it. When it is down — R her — the realm is yours.
edits.after: Riposte: 24s at rank 1, parries all damage, and stuns you if it blocked your pull. Bait it, then R.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + Health Potion. Core: Liandry's Torment  (burn carries his extended trades), then Riftmaker; boots Plated Steelcaps. First back: Lost Chapter component / Bami's (≈900-1300g).
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + Health Potion. Core: Liandry's Torment, then Riftmaker, plus Grievous Wounds — her Vitals and Grand Challenge both heal; boots Plated Steelcaps. First back: Bami's (≈900-1300g).

edits.before: Levels 4-5 she stacks cardinal Vitals for percent-max-HP true damage that ignores your shield, and her Q dashes kite your slow Obliterate out of Darkness Rise range.
edits.after: At 3 her Lunge dashes kite your slow Obliterate out of Darkness Rise range, and every Vital she hits heals her back — she owns this level, so do not contest it.

edits.before: Realm of Death rips her into a 1v1 with no terrain to Vital and no team to peel — your aura and W heal win that isolated fight, so 6 is yours.
edits.after: Through 4-5 your Obliterate is down to 6s and Darkness Rise is rolling — pull her off her Vital and the extended trade is yours before her items land.

edits.before: Her first-item Vitals and a W parry-stun flip your engage; once true damage chunks past your shield, the trade math favours her, not you.
edits.after: At 6 her Grand Challenge is 110s to your 140s, and four Vitals plus its heal out-duel you even in the realm — hold R for when hers is spent.

notes: Left alone, recorded as unverified: five fields call Vital procs "percent-max-HP true damage". Riot’s passive text says only that hitting a Vital restores Health and grants Move Speed, and the trueDamage flag sits on Grand Challenge rather than the passive — so I neither repeated nor removed the claim. Mordekaiser Q’s derived grounding flag not asserted. Whether Riposte can parry Realm of Death itself is not answerable from the kit (R is a banish, not damage), so nothing on the page now claims it either way. Unresolved and worth a human call: spikes[1].text and mid still describe Level 6 as the window Mordekaiser owns, while the chart on both sides now gives Level 6 to Fiora.
